discharge-stemi-001.title: Cardiac discharge summary with medication interaction context
discharge-stemi-001.text: DISCHARGE SUMMARY: 72-year-old male with Type 2 Diabetes on Metformin 500mg and Lisinopril 10mg. Recent STEMI with PCI to RCA. Started on Aspirin 81mg and Clopidogrel 75mg. History of hypertension and CKD stage 3.

wire-alert-001.title: High-value international wire with a new beneficiary
wire-alert-001.text: TRANSACTION ALERT: Customer C-1842 initiated a $48,750 wire transfer to Northstar Trading in Estonia. This is a new beneficiary and the customer's first international wire. The login originated in Chicago from a recognized device. The account is 8 years old and the prior maximum wire was $6,200. Transaction ID TX-94721.
